Then the target adds them again from the intermediate output path, which might not be caught by the SDK's default glob since `obj/` is typically excluded from the standard include patterns. the actual files from disk, so when you run `dotnet clean`, the generated `.g.cs` files remain on disk even though they're removed from the Compile item group. The target needs to actually delete those files during the clean operation, not just remove them from the project metadata. The real problem is that `FileWrites` is a static ItemGroup evaluated before targets run, so it can't capture files written during execution. For the cross-product batching issue in ValidateGeneratedCode, referencing both `%(ProtoFile.Filename)` and `%(ValidationRule.Filename)` in the same Message task creates a 3 × 2 cross-product instead of validating each proto file against all rules sequentially. I need to restructure this so the target batches on ProtoFile and iterates through the validation rules inside.

The SDK's default glob already includes `**/*.cs` files, so explicitly re-adding `**\*.g.cs` causes CS2002 duplicate source file warnings. The real problem is that FileWrites is meant to be populated during target execution so the Clean target knows what was actually generated, not what might be generated. If a build hasn't run yet, FileWrites would still list files that don't exist. Plus, since these files are in the obj/ folder, they'll get cleaned by the regular Clean target anyway, which deletes the entire obj/ directory, so FileWrites might cause redundant cleaning or try to remove files that are already handled.

The generated files need to be included in Compile outside the target or in a target that always runs.

     <ValidationRule Include="rules\naming-conventions.rule" />
   </ItemGroup>
 
   <!-- Generate code from proto definitions -->
   <Target Name="GenerateProtoCode" BeforeTargets="CoreCompile"
       Inputs="@(ProtoFile)"
       Outputs="@(ProtoFile->'$(IntermediateOutputPath)%(Filename).g.cs')">
 
     <Message Text="Generating %(ProtoFile.Filename) for service %(ProtoFile.Service)"
              Importance="high" />
 
     <WriteLinesToFile
         File="$(IntermediateOutputPath)%(ProtoFile.Filename).g.cs"
         Lines="// Generated from %(ProtoFile.Identity)"
         Overwrite="true" />
 
     <!-- Track generated files for clean inside the target that writes them -->
     <ItemGroup>
       <FileWrites Include="$(IntermediateOutputPath)%(ProtoFile.Filename).g.cs" />
     </ItemGroup>
   </Target>
 
   <!-- Validate each proto file against all rules.
        Batch the target on ProtoFile so it runs once per proto (3 times).
        Inside, iterate ValidationRule separately to avoid cross-product batching. -->
   <Target Name="ValidateGeneratedCode" AfterTargets="GenerateProtoCode"
       Outputs="%(ProtoFile.Filename)">
     <Message Text="Validating %(ProtoFile.Filename)" Importance="high" />
     <Message Text="  rule: %(ValidationRule.Filename)" Importance="high" />
   </Target>
 
   <!-- Clean up only the proto-generated files -->
   <Target Name="CleanGeneratedCode" BeforeTargets="Clean">
     <Delete Files="@(ProtoFile->'$(IntermediateOutputPath)%(Filename).g.cs')" />
   </Target>
 </Project>

| **CS2002 warnings** | `<Compile Include="**\*.g.cs">` duplicates SDK's default `**/*.cs` glob | Changed to `<Compile Update="**\*.g.cs">` — attaches metadata without re-adding |
| **Files lost on incremental builds** | `<Compile Include>` was inside the target, skipped when inputs are up-to-date | Moved to a static `<ItemGroup>` using `@(ProtoFile->'...')` transform |
| **FileWrites in static context** | Static `<FileWrites>` tracked files even when they weren't generated | Moved into `GenerateProtoCode` target so only actually-written files are tracked |
